content:
Returns a list of tag properties that can be used for filters on endpoints that support them. For
example, the properties that are returned by this endpoint can be used as filters for the Search tags
endpoint.
In addition to the tag properties, the results list includes the logical operators you can use with the
tag properties along with the supported values.
Caution: This endpoint is available for use but is currently in beta. The response structure is subject
to change as we continue to enhance the data model.
Requires the Basic [16] user role or the ASSET_INVENTORY.CYBER_ASSET_MANAGEMENT.READ  and
AD.TOGGLE_AD.USE  custom role privileges. See Roles.
